interpretation: The 17 human-reviewed units are a development and regression calibration set. Complete agreement after rule revision demonstrates that protocol 2.0.0 encodes the observed human corrections; it is not an independent estimate of accuracy, precision, recall, F1, prevalence or generalisation.
calibration_changes: separate semantic surface role from access and collection state
treat collector blocks and redirects as access states rather than semantic surface classes when role is recoverable
expand search_or_index to explicit search routes and thematic or nested archive indexes
treat configured observation root as homepage unless a stronger semantic role is identified
reduce isolated press or presse lexical dominance over editorial classification
require item specificity before item-level classification
allow structurally specific audiovisual routes to remain audiovisual_item when playback is unavailable
preserve item_record when a record route lacks audiovisual media or structured audiovisual evidence
next_gate: Freeze protocol 2.0.0 and evaluate it on a new independent blind sample whose automatic predictions are durably persisted and SHA-256 hashed before human review.
